newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Montenegro steelworks expects to realise '97 plan.
newsitem.headline: Montenegro steelworks expects to realise '97 plan.

text.p: BELGRADE, May 27 (Tanjug) - Montenegro steel works Zeljezara Niksic expects to achieve its 1997 target despite continuing difficulties, the company's assembly was quoted by Tanjug news agency as saying on Tuesday.
The 1997 target was to produce 124,490 tonnes of raw steel, purchase 41,000 tonnes of semi manufactured goods, process 145,500 tonnes of steel and sell 155,000 tonnes of steel products.
The planned total revenue is expected to be a little over 490 million dinars ($88 million).
The steel works is facing a shortage of raw materials and difficulties in selling finished products, which result in low capacity utilisation.
But results so far show that with special efforts it will be possible to realise this year's plan, the assembly said.
In the first quarter this year Zeljezara Niksic produced 32,416 tonnes of raw steel, 36,590 tonnes of finished products and sold 41,000 tonnes of steel products.
In 1996 the steel works registered a loss of 107 million dinars. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 43 05
